questions.q: The term 'strangury' in a rubric means:
opts: slow, painful passing of urine drop by drop with straining
passing large amounts of urine at night
questions.why: Strangury is painful, drop-by-drop urination with tenesmus, as in Cantharis.

questions.q: C. M. Boger's approach to repertorisation gave special importance to:
questions.why: Topic 4, Repertory. Boger used pathological generals and causation.

questions.q: The commonest heart defect in congenital rubella syndrome is (GPSC Medical Officer, 2024):
questions.why: Topic 8, Obstetrics, Gynaecology and Paediatrics. Rubella triad: PDA, cataract, deafness.

questions.q: The serological marker most specific for rheumatoid arthritis is:
questions.why: Anti-CCP has a specificity of about 95% for RA; rheumatoid factor is also found in other diseases and in healthy elderly people.

questions.q: Boenninghausen's Therapeutic Pocket Book was edited in English in 1891 by:
questions.why: Topic 4, Repertory. Timothy F. Allen's edition is the one in common use.

questions.q: The aphorism that states that in no case is it necessary, and therefore not permissible, to give the patient more than one single simple medicine at a time is:
questions.why: §273 states the rule of the single remedy (simplex); §§272 to 274 deal with it.

questions.q: For the LM potency (Organon §270), one grain of the 3C trituration is dissolved in 500 drops of a mixture of:
opts: one part alcohol and four parts water
four parts alcohol and one part water
questions.why: §270 directs that the grain be dissolved in 500 drops of a mixture of one part alcohol to four parts distilled water.

questions.q: After a snakebite, blood that fails to clot in the 20-minute whole blood clotting test indicates envenomation by a:
questions.why: Viper venom is haemotoxic and causes coagulopathy; cobra and krait venoms are neurotoxic.

questions.q: A patient who feels unusually well the day before an attack of illness, with marked chilliness and offensive discharges, needs:
questions.why: Psorinum (Allen's Keynotes): feels unusually well the day before an attack.

questions.q: According to J. H. Allen, the tubercular diathesis (pseudo-psora) is a combination of:
opts: all three miasms in equal parts
questions.why: J. H. Allen in 'The Chronic Miasms' regarded pseudo-psora (the tubercular diathesis) as a mixed miasm of psora and syphilis.
